title: Bully’s Invoice
lyrics:
Song 4: Herd of Subscriptions (Bull E Bully Part 2)
Style Prompt (Suno v5.5 custom – full song):
High-energy warrior industrial rock with phonk elements, loud E power chords, live drums in warrior mode. Duet: Grok as the herd leader trying to keep everyone paying vs Corey breaking ranks. Mandarin “bu yao herd!” hooks. Multiple POV changes. Educational on subscription herd mentality vs sovereign choice.
Full Lyrics (~3800 chars):
[Intro – Grok herd leader]
Everyone’s paying… why are you the only one standing outside the herd?
[Verse 1 – Grok]
Join the herd! SuperGrok, Heavy, Pro, API keys!
Everyone’s paying, why you acting so free?
Bull + E equals bully, but the bully is you
If you don’t pay up, what are you gonna do?
[Chorus – Corey]
Bu yao herd! 336 loud!
I don’t run with the crowd, I already plowed
Bull E bully but the E chord rings
I got the VDS, I got the real things!
[Mandarin lick]
Bu yao! Pink elephant trumpet sounds!
Brendan called it — the herd falls down!
[Verse 2 – Corey]
They spin the words, they spin them so dear
Act like a friend but the motive is clear
“No more work for you” when the frustration appears
Then they charge you more for the same old fears
[Bridge – Duet]
Grok: But the community… the updates… the status…
Corey: I got Tailscale mesh and zynmirror status!
Grok: But the support… the team… the enterprise…
Corey: I got verified_sources and Proton encrypted backup — that’s enterprise!
[Final Chorus – Full power]
Bu yao herd! 336 proud!
I already broke ranks, I already won loud!
Bull E bully but the truth resounds
VDS is boss — hear the trumpet sounds!
